title: Customer Structural Record
description: Structural Customer graph node. Legal name, customer type, anonymity, and commercial relationships belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Customer graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Customer contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary customer name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label; it may be a neutral placeholder and is never the legal name.

parent_customer_id.description: Optional structural edge to a parent Customer graph node; ownership details remain Facts.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not the customer's business status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted customer facts.
